frankly_franz: Rafael "Owl" Franz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Rafael "Owl" Franz said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. A letter from home reached Rafael "Owl" Franz before dusk. Rafael "Owl" Franz read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Rafael "Owl" Franz tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F4 is up. Rafael "Owl" Franz raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps).
proto_guyy: In Lindenbruck, Oskar "Smokes" Guyy was a medical student. In R-F14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy answered the first call, number 69 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Oskar "Smokes" Guyy came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
The rain did not stop once. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy slept standing up, wedged against the wall of R-F14, and dreamt of dry socks.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Oskar "Smokes" Guyy tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F14 is up.
rei0_shi4: The new rifleman is Severin "Lucky" Shi, once a coal miner from Saint-Lune. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Severin "Lucky" Shi said he would find out.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F8, Severin "Lucky" Shi listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The salvo walked along R-F8 and caught Severin "Lucky" Shi in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos.
Severin "Lucky" Shi spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
No bed for Severin "Lucky" Shi yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
santiago.g.adauto: Day 5. The corporal put Karel Adauto beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Karel Adauto's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Karel Adauto before dusk. Karel Adauto read it twice and slept a little easier.
